## See where Support Fins leaves overhangs bare

When the auto fins are in place, Support Fins now checks every overhang:

- Overhangs a fin holds turn pale. Anything further than **Bare beyond** (5 mm to start with) from the top of a fin, or from a wall of the part it grows out of, stays **bright red**.
- The panel's new **Held** line says how much of the overhang is held, how many bare spots there are and how far the worst one is from a support, e.g. *91% held · 6 bare spots, the worst 6.6 mm from a support*.
- Fix them with Placement › Full coverage, more Wide-face coverage, or by drawing fins there in *Add fins*. The check runs again after every change, and also counts fins you add by hand or remove.
- Lower *Bare beyond* for a stricter check (bridging a few millimetres usually prints; much more than 5 mm sags).

The check runs in the background, so the window stays responsive on big parts.
